Need source->feature->intent->mechanics->DMX->visible optics diagnosis, especially holds, gesture extrema/onsets/offsets, motif/phrase recurrence and relational timing. Rank/different hashes/nonzero movement alone not success.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: NO autonomous temporal oscillator/sine/beat chases/random motion/canned time choreography, no borrowed song's body. Body freeze must give constant motion (and brightness for constant pose); no phases added to spread outputs. Trig solely coordinate math fine. A body-dependent instantaneous/whole-path deterministic transform is allowed; avoid state inertia that drifts during holds. Extra N outputs are manifestations of gestures, not independent dance sources. No warping source timing to satisfy mechanics, prefer spatial amplitude adaptation. Paper inspiration must honestly distinguished from reproducing authors' algorithms. No training expensive new models, no copyrighted-video target fetching. SharedGPU RTX5070 12GB in use by another audio-representation campaign (MAE/JEPA/contrastive). Use saved bodies,CPU numpy/scipy/optimization. Research/CPU stays independent of GPU queue; later GPU rendering serialized under sharedlocks. Other agent findings can inform diagnostics but no unqualified encoder or new color/model substitution.
Need literature in articulated/nonhuman motion retargeting, bone/angular/relational representations,interaction mesh/Laplacian/differential coordinates,topology/skeleton-aware transfer,shape/point-set alignment,optimal transport/formation control,gesture style/Laban descriptors,visibility/perception and spatiotemporal trajectory optimization constrained robot retargeting. Return exactly15 variants, not15gain tweaks. For each: actual paper title/year/authors and verified-looking URL/arXivID (explicitly flag uncertain IDs); exact borrowed mechanism vs original LightSem adaptation; equations/pseudocode mapping body+fixed geometry+capabilities to directions/targets and intensities; how it scales to N; source-freeze and limb sensitivity properties; what failure it targets; expected effect on preregisterable emitted-output metric; computational feasibility and likely failure. Include 8–12 distinct primary research papers, favour arXiv fulltext for subsequent MCP verification; you may include landmark non-arXiv papers as explicitly supplementary. Do not assume paper generalization to lights. Flag nominal novelty vs existing methods. Explain a minimal shared API separating intent from constraints and sensible controls for non-artistic engineering validity. Do not claim any unrun experiment works.
